Very pretty! Always liked looking at those glass catfish at our LFSs. Do they just sort of hang out or school around and do neat things?

They typically hang out for the most part. They school very tightly, and generally stick to the middle of the tank. When they move, they do it as a group. The more comfortable they are, the more you'll see them.

When I first got them they hid in the shade of the plants for about 2 days. Now they sit in the dead center of the tank most of the time looking at everything.
